body:
# MultipleSessions

**MultipleSessions** is a simple Minecraft plugin that lets players have separate gameplay _sessions_ on the same server.

A _session_ is like starting over. Different inventory, position, etc. You can create as many as you want and switch between them.

# Commands:
```
    /createsession <id-number>
    Creates a new session with the given ID.

    /changesession <id-number>
    Switches you to the session with that ID.

    /viewsession
    Shows your current session ID.
```


This is useful if you want to start fresh without deleting your current progress, or try different playthroughs without needing a new server.
